entities.name: TMSI status
entities.description: An information element indicating the status of the TMSI availability in the UE.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: A procedure where the UE performs both EPS attach and non-EPS services attach simultaneously.

entities.name: No valid TMSI available
entities.description: Condition where the UE does not have a valid Temporary Mobile Subscriber Identity stored.

relations.description: The combined attach procedure includes the TMSI status information element.
The inclusion of TMSI status IE is conditional on the UE having no valid TMSI available.
